gen-eater-gf-jaldi: Approachable and brushed-looking, Jaldi packs its tall lowercase tightly, with a gaping c you notice at any size. Eater above it is the darker voice, its strokes swelling gently along each curve, while the sans-serif below stays low in contrast.
gen-eater-gf-kdam-thmor-pro: Dark, jagged and a little menacing up top. Eater sets that mood with wide gaps between letters, and Kdam Thmor Pro follows in modern plain sans form, its bowls filling the line with confidence.
gen-eater-gf-krona-one: Krona One reads loose and wide, its lowercase built like cast iron capitals. Eater does the moody, sturdy-hairline drama best, while the plain sans simply spreads out and keeps things approachable.
gen-eater-gf-magra: Eater growls in thin strokes that dip only modestly beside its weightier stems, while Magra settles in below with a big-bodied feel. Dark meets sturdy.
gen-eater-gf-major-mono-display: Major Mono Display reads like neon glass, with wide sidebearings and curves that sweep open instead of curling shut. Major Mono Display keeps a precise, technical hum going under Eater's sturdy hairlines, so a longer passage would feel spaced out and glowing.
gen-eater-gf-martian-mono: Eater's bowls thin gracefully rather than sharply, and its letters sit far apart for a dark, aggressive look. Martian Mono takes over below as fixed-width monospace, its strokes uniform and its curves wide open, so a modest size lets it breathe.
gen-eater-gf-matemasie: Matemasie looks marker-drawn and plain, with broad gaps between glyphs. Its strongest quality is that friendly looseness against Eater, whose strokes narrow gradually from stem to terminal for a dark, aggressive edge.
gen-eater-gf-menbere: Menbere stacks its lowercase tall, like rolled cord, and keeps a clean, low-contrast stroke throughout. Eater, meanwhile, adds a medium swell and taper of weight for the dark mood on top.
gen-eater-gf-mitr: Approachable and contemporary, Mitr squeezes almost no gap between its x-height and cap height. And that compact uniformity is the pair's strongest quality, set against Eater's dark hairlines that are neither wispy nor heavy.
gen-eater-gf-momo-trust-display: Clean and professional, Momo Trust Display lets its letters drift apart. Eater brings a dark, aggressive edge with bowls that thin slightly at the sides, and the generous sans underneath gives that edge room.
